Zar y primer emperador de Rusia, impulso: Tsar and first emperor of Russia, driving deep military and administrative reforms. He founded St. Petersburg and decisively directed the Russian state towards the Baltic and Western Europe.
Zarina de la dinastía Lopujin. Su trayec: Zarina of the Lopujin dynasty. Her trajectory is linked to Russia.
Zarina de la dinastía Miloslavski. Su tr: Zarina of the Miloslavski dynasty. Her trajectory is linked to Russia.
Zarina de la dinastía Romanov. Su trayec: Zarina of the Romanov dynasty. Her trajectory is linked to Russia.
Zarina de la dinastía Saltykov. Su traye: Zarina of the Saltykov dynasty. Her trajectory is linked to Russia.
Zarévich de la dinastía Romanov. Su tray: Zarevich of the Romanov dynasty. His trajectory is linked to Russia.
Zarévna de la dinastía Welf. Su trayecto: Zarevna of the Welf dynasty. Her trajectory is linked to Brunswick, Russia.
el Rey de Hierro y Oro: the King of Iron and Gold
Ámbito occidental heredado de Galeazzo h: Western area inherited from Galeazzo until 1385; then reunified government. The ducal title begins in 1395, without erasing its previous lordship.
Étienne Aubert, jurista lemosín, fue pap: Étienne Aubert, a Lenin jurist, was pope in Avignon between 1352 and 1362. He sent Cardinal Gil de Albornoz to recover for the Holy See the government of the Pontifical States.
Íñigo Fernández de Velasco y Tovar: Inigo Fernández de Velasco and Tovar
Íñigo López de Loyola, nacido en una fam: Inigo López de Loyola, born in a family of the small Basque nobility, changed his life after being wounded in the defense of Pamplona in 1521. His spiritual experience gave rise to the Exercises. In Paris he brought together the companions of the future Society of Jesus, approved by Paul III in 1540, of which he was the first Superior General.
Última noticia vital; no es un año de mu: Last vital news; it's not an exact year of death.
Última soberana Estuardo, reina de Ingla: Last sovereign Stuart, Queen of England, Scotland and Ireland since 1702. Under his reign the Union of 1707 was approved, which created the kingdom of Britain; none of his sons survived him.
Último Hohenstaufen, nieto de Federico I: Last Hohenstaufen, grandson of Frederick II. At sixteen years old he tried to recover Sicily from Charles of Anjou; defeated in Tagliacozzo (1268), he was beheaded in Naples.
Último conde de Pallars. Encabezó el par: Last Count of Pallars. He led the pactist party in the Catalan civil war against John II, who had him imprisoned from 1466 to 1470, and was excluded from the capitulation of Pedralbes (1472). Fernando II's troops conquered Pallars between 1484 and 1488, and in 1491 the county passed to the Cardona as marquesado. Captured in Italy by the Great Captain in 1503, he died prisoner in the castle of Xàtiva in 1508.
Último de los hermanos que obtuvo el mar: The last of the brothers who obtained the mark with French recognition, succeeded Francis in 1537. His government developed under a strong dependence on France.
Último duque de Jülich-Cléveris-Berg de: Last Duke of Jülich-Clébéris-Berg of his line. His death without children in 1609 opened a successor dispute involving Brandenburg, Palatinate-Neuburg and the great neighbouring powers.
Último duque masculino de la casa de los: The last male duke of the house of the Griphs. He died without descent in 1637, and the question of his inheritance contributed to the distribution of Pomerania between Sweden and Brandenburg.
Último elector y primer rey de Sajonia (: Last elector and first king of Saxony (1806). Allied to Napoleon, he was also Duke of Warsaw since 1807; in 1815 he lost about half of his kingdom to Prussia.
Último emperador bizantino. Murió defend: Last Byzantine emperor. He died defending Constantinople during the siege of 1453, and his death was associated with the end of the Roman Empire of the East.
Último emperador de Trebisonda, buscó ap: Last emperor of Trebizond, he sought external support before the Ottoman conquest of 1461. He was executed in 1463. The loss of government and his death were different events; the record retains both dates.
Último emperador del Sacro Imperio y pri: Last emperor of the Holy Roman Empire and first emperor of Austria since 1804. He fought revolutionary and Napoleonic France, dissolved the Empire in 1806 and married his daughter Mary Louise to Napoleon.
Último estatúder de las Provincias Unida: The last stadtholder of the United Provinces (1751–1795). He left for exile in England in 1795, before the arrival of the French and the proclamation of the Batava Republic.
Último gobernante varón de la rama tirol: Last male ruler of the Tyrolean branch; Tyrol passed to Leopold I after his death.
Último gran duque Valois de Borgoña. Mur: Last Grand Duke Valois of Burgundy. He died before Nancy in 1477; the French Crown incorporated the duchy, while his daughter Mary inherited rights over the Netherlands and the Franche-Comté. The inheritance was disputed and did not remain as a united State.
Último gran maestre de la Orden Teutónic: The last great master of the Teutonic Order in Prussia. In 1525 he secularized his lands as a Duchy of Prussia, a vassal of Poland, and adopted Lutheranism; in 1544 he founded the University of Königsberg.
Último rey Habsburgo de España. Su falta: Last Habsburg king of Spain. His lack of descent turned his succession into a European question and, after his death, triggered the Spanish War of Succession.
Último rey Jagellón de Polonia y gran du: Last King Jagellon of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania. Under his reign the Union of Lublin of 1569 created the Polish-Lituan Commonwealth.
Último rey Trastámara de Nápoles (1496–1: Last Trastámara king of Naples (1496–1501). Louis XII of France and Ferdinand the Catholic divided their kingdom by the treaty of Granada (1500); Frederick surrendered to the French and died in Tours in 1504.
Último rey de Francia del Antiguo Régime: The last king of France of the Old Regime. The financial crisis and the convening of the General States led to the French Revolution, which ended with the monarchy and its execution.
Último rey de Jerusalén que gobernó desd: Last king of Jerusalem who ruled from Acre. After the fall of the city in 1291 he retained the title of Jerusalem while continuing as king of Cyprus.
Último rey de Kartli-Kajetia, heredó una: Last king of Kartli-Kajetia, inherited a monarchy weakened by Persian invasion and family disputes. He applied for Russian protection, but his death preceded the annexation of the kingdom. Dynastic succession did not become another effective reign.
Último rey de Thomond antes del acuerdo: Last king of Thomond before the surrender and restitution agreement with Henry VIII. He gave his Gaelic rights and received titles from the Crown. His former royalty and the county are distinguished, whose succession did not follow exactly the same rules.
Último rey de la casa de Valois. Su rein: The last king of the house of Valois. His reign was dominated by the wars of religion and the struggle between the Catholic League, the Huguenots and the monarchic authority itself.
Única hija de Filippo Maria Visconti, du: The only daughter of Filippo Maria Visconti, Duke of Milan. Her marriage to Condottiere Francesco Sforza (1441) allowed him to take the duchy in 1450.
Única hija superviviente de Thomas, X co: The only surviving daughter of Thomas, X Earl of Ormond, received a significant share of family property. Her marriage to Richard Preston and her daughter Elizabeth's inheritance altered the balance between title and heritage within the Butlers.
El ducado de Dijon era un feudo francés;: The Duchy of Burgundy, centred on Dijon, was a French fief; the County of Burgundy was an imperial fief. Nevers and Rethel passed to a junior branch. After 1477 France took the duchy; the claims of Mary and her heirs did not amount to possession.
Las victorias yorkistas de Hedgeley Moor: The York victories of Hedgeley Moor and Hexham in 1464 weaken the resistance of the north. Henry VI will be captured the following year. Edward seeks to consolidate his government and reward the servants who have sustained his cause. His decision to marry in secret Elizabeth Woodville, a noble widow of a Lancastrian knight, alters the division of influence in the court. The brothers and children of Elizabeth’s first marriage enter the network of royal patronage. Warwick, who intervenes in the king’s matrimonial diplomacy, sees his ability to direct foreign policy reduced. Edward’s approach to Burgundy, culminating with his sister Margaret’s marriage to Charles the Bold in 1468, deepens the separation between them.
Warwick desembarca en Inglaterra y la op: Warwick disembarks in England and the opposition to Edward is spreading. The king flees to the Netherlands with his brother Richard of Gloucester. Henry VI leaves the Tower and regains the throne in the autumn of 1470. The government depends on the military power of Warwick and the pact with Margaret. Restoration modifies European alliances: France wants to confront England with Burgundy. Charles the Bold is married to Margaret of York, Edward’s sister, and ends up supporting the return of his brother-in-law. Clarence, meanwhile, discovers that Lancaster’s restoration favors Edward of Westminster. His reconciliation with his brother will be one of the conditions of the next regime change.
